data.narrative:
Asymm is a Seed-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $6M to date. The Space & Aerospace sector comprises 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, though none of these peers operate at a sufficiently comparable stage or valuation tier to support narrow peer-median analysis.

The primary valuation method applied is stage-progression analysis, which uses the $6M in total raised as a proxy for current valuation and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage step-ups in venture capital. This produces an implied valuation of $15M. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples cannot be applied due to the absence of revenue data for private companies. Peer-median triangulation was not feasible; the 14 same-sector peers identified did not yield the minimum three datapoints required at matched stage or similar valuation tier.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $13M to $17M, centered on $15M. This range reflects the stage-progression method ±15%. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue visibility to validate against public market multiples (27.4x P/S median), the lack of sufficiently granular private peer data at Seed stage, and the broader early-stage risk profile typical of frontier aerospace ventures. Investors should treat this as a preliminary estimate pending additional fundraising context or operational milestones.
